about.title: About Life-Coaching AI
about.paragraph1: Life-Coaching AI gives you a private space to think things through, explore your feelings, and work toward meaningful goals. If you choose to sign in, your goals help the AI understand your direction — so the guidance stays relevant without needing to repeat yourself.
about.whyMattersParagraph: Finding your direction in life is not easy. Real life-coaching is built on asking the right questions — the ones that help you think deeper, gain clarity, and make choices that truly belong to you. Skilled life-coaches study for years to master this approach because asking the wrong questions can unintentionally push a person toward the wrong path.
about.whyAiCanHelpParagraph: Life-Coaching AI uses structured coaching techniques consistently and without personal biases. It doesn’t judge, get distracted, or project its own emotions onto you. Because it has no personal interests, it cannot influence you for its own benefit. Instead, it focuses entirely on helping you think clearly, reflect honestly, and make decisions aligned with your own values and goals.
about.whyAppExistsParagraph: Professional life coaching can be expensive and inaccessible. This app offers guidance, structure, and emotional clarity to anyone — privately, affordably, and at your own pace.
about.howItWorksBullet1: Anonymous Chat — start talking instantly, no login needed.
about.howItWorksBullet2: Personalized Coaching — after signing in, your goals become part of the conversation.
about.howItWorksBullet3: Goal Tracking — add, edit, and organize goals like simple notes.
about.howItWorksBullet4: Account Control — delete your account and all data anytime.
about.howItWorksBullet5: Mobile + Web — use whichever is more comfortable for you.
about.privacyFirstParagraph: Your conversations and goals are private. The app does not use ads or tracking. You can delete your account and all stored data at any moment from the menu.
